text_anchors: Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust?

approvals.quote: I always trust our own projects because the only two people working on them are you and I.
approvals.approving: This handler's exact spec as the PM presented it: on a lane lane-restart just relaunched, if the screen contains verbatim "Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust?", "Yes, I trust this folder" and a path beginning "C:\Projects\", press Down then Enter (selecting "Yes, I trust this folder"; the default is "No, exit"). Applies to folders under C:\Projects only; any other path means no answer. First seen on the unisql relaunch at 2026-10-14T16:04:30Z.
